mentions.name: Reading is a System!
mentions.description: This project helps people achieve their reading goals by hosting workshops at libraries, guiding adults to become more intentional about their reading goals and how to achieve them.
mentions.audience: Adults looking to become more intentional about their reading goals, reached through workshops hosted at libraries
mentions.source_excerpt:
Reading is a System! https://reading-is-a-system.vercel.app/

I've been helping people achieve their reading goals by hosting workshops at libraries and helping adults become more intentional about their reading goals and how to achieve them.
